text:
You need a developer who can join your existing Cloud9 AWS environment, plug a chat module into your current UI, and connect it to the OpenAI API so user input triggers a sequence of responses.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, NLP, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, and scikit-learn. In a recent project, I built a call-centre speech analytics pipeline for Vantor Call Centers that transcribed calls, separated agent and customer audio, and generated QA summaries for every call. That system processed 2,300 hours of audio and expanded QA coverage from 3% to 100% of calls.

For your project, I can write the back-end chat module, integrate it into your AWS environment, and build the OpenAI response function to work with your existing front-end view.
